slides.text: *Minute 1:* Jo dimaag mein hai, sab likho.
*Minute 2:* Jo tumhare haath mein hai, uspe tick.
*Minute 3:* Jo haath mein nahi hai, kaat do.
*Minute 4:* Tick wali cheez mein se *ek* chuno.
*Minute 5:* Wohi ek kaam abhi shuru karo.
Save karo. Raat ko kaam aayega.
slides.sub: Roz ka ek rule, follow karo
